text_en: Tom and his mum were tourists in a new city.
They wanted to visit an old temple, but they didn't know the way.
Tom's mum asked a woman for directions.
The woman told them to go straight on along the street.
Then they had to turn right at the roundabout and walk over the bridge.
The temple was at the end of the road, opposite a big fountain.
Tom and his mum followed the directions.
They passed a bakery and a petrol station.
After fifteen minutes, they saw the fountain.
The temple was beautiful, and they took a lot of photos.

questions.q: Who did Tom's mum ask for directions?
